Chapter 451: Chapter 3: He Was Born for the Martial Dao (Please Subscribe)

On the other side of the summit.

The initially disinterested figures, each occupied in their own conversations, barely paid attention to the one sensing the Martial Ancestor’s Divine Radiance.

There was no helping it; behind the first group of invited Martial Tao geniuses, many of the sensors who had got in through back doors performed dismally.

None of them had a Martial Tao compatibility of more than ten percent.

If the Martial Ancestor’s Divine Radiance wasn’t so crucial, requiring their supervision upon activation, they probably would have left a long time ago.

“It’s about to end.”

...

The leading figure was the Great Supreme Elder of the Martial Temple, ranking just below the three who were out waging war in the Seventh Stage Martial Tao.

He glanced casually at the site of the Martial Ancestor’s Divine Radiance below.

The next moment.

The Great Supreme Elder’s pupils constricted sharply.

In his sight, strands of the Martial Ancestor’s Divine Radiance bubbled up as one divine statue after another began to emit twelvefold radiance.

For a moment, inside the walls, at the site where the seven divine statues were placed, the Martial Ancestor’s Divine Radiance nearly spilled out.

“What’s this?”

The Great Supreme Elder’s heart shook with awe; the only possible reason for the Martial Ancestor’s Divine Radiance to be actively attracted was the presence of a sensor with overwhelmingly powerful Martial Talent, causing the full revival of the Divine Radiance.

This event had taken place several times over the past hundred thousand years, but the attraction to the Martial Ancestor’s Divine Radiance never reached the scale of today…

“Divine statues blooming with twelvefold light… and seven statues at that… Am I dreaming?” another Supreme Elder murmured to himself.

The seven divine statues represent seven different directions of Martial Tao.

Such as prowess in killing, excellence in defense, mastery over domains… and so on.

Since the establishment of the Martial Temple, indeed, there had been examiners who caused several divine statues to simultaneously bloom with radiance, but that was at most three or four statues, and each statue’s radiance did not exceed seventy percent.

Like now?

Twelvefold radiance?

And all seven statues at that?

“Genius.”

“The strongest talent ever since the founding of our Martial Temple.”

The several Supreme Elders quickly recovered, and as strong Martial Tao Sixth Rank experts, they should not have been so flustered.

But the scene unfolding before them was simply too inconceivable.

…

In front of the seven divine statues.

Lin Yuan quietly felt the submission emanating from the Martial Ancestor’s Divine Radiance.

The so-called Martial Ancestor’s Divine Radiance was nothing more than the traces of the ‘Dao’ and ‘Law’ that Lin Yuan had left on the seven divine statues, now stimulated by an external force.

It was sensitizing him to the most suitable physique and talent for Martial Tao cultivation.

Ever since the Consciousness Descent, Lin Yuan was not only steadily recovering his strength but also allowing this physical body to undergo metamorphosis.

As the once Ancestor of Martial Arts, the direction in which Lin Yuan would transform his body would undoubtedly be the most suitable for Martial Tao.

The performance of the Martial Ancestor’s Divine Radiance merely reflected the breath of an Ultimate Physique within the Martial Tao Cultivation System.

Such a physique was basically impossible to be born naturally, only appearing under the guidance of Lin Yuan, the Ancestor of Martial Arts.

Of course, this was unknown to outsiders, and even those three Seventh Rank old ancestors were clueless.

By the side.

The elder in a black robe was still engulfed in incredible shock.

Having activated the Martial Ancestor’s Divine Radiance so many times, he had never felt such a scene within the Divine Radiance before.

And the fact that all seven statues burst forth with twelvefold light also left this black-robed elder somewhat befuddled.

For an examiner to make a statue shine with twelvefold light was rare enough for tens of thousands of years, but to have all seven statues do so?

Just as the black-robed elder wondered what to do next,

several figures appeared silently beside him, their eyes burning with fervent gaze upon Lin Yuan.

A Martial Tao talent the likes of which had never been seen before.

Heaven blesses our Martial Temple,

Heaven blesses our Martial Tao.

These sudden figures were the Supreme Elders of the Martial Temple.

“Supreme Elders…”

The elder in the black robe couldn’t help but startle.

Then he quickly realized.

If even he had noticed the anomaly in the Martial Ancestor’s Divine Radiance, how could the Supreme Elders have missed it?

“You may leave.”

The lead Great Supreme Elder gave the black-robed elder a glance.

“Yes.”

The black-robed elder bowed immediately and quickly exited.

“Young friend.”

The Great Supreme Elder conjured a trace of a gentle smile and greeted Lin Yuan before he seriously said, “I wonder if you would be willing to join our Martial Temple?”

Having said this,

including the Great Supreme Elder himself,

a tinge of nervousness appeared on all their faces.

With the influence of the Martial Temple, they could indeed force Lin Yuan to join.

As the ‘heaven’ of Xianyao City, who would dare refuse the Martial Temple’s decree?

But that was something they did to outsiders. Given Lin Yuan’s currently revealed terrifying talent, he would likely take charge of the Martial Temple in the future.

In such a case, who would dare to coerce? Did they not fear retribution later on?

For a peerless Martial Tao genius who could revive the Martial Temple, coercion was the most foolish method.

“Join the Martial Temple?”

Lin Yuan looked towards the Supreme Elders of the Martial Temple.

In fact, with his grasp over his own powers, he could have completely blocked the sensing of the Martial Ancestor’s Divine Radiance.

But Lin Yuan did not.

The aim was to attract the attention of the Martial Temple and then join it, utilizing the Temple’s vast Cultivation Resources to swiftly recover his strength.

The Martial Temple existed precisely to transcend the Martial Tao Cultivation System; it was inherently a force under Lin Yuan’s command.

It even matched part of Lin Yuan’s plans for the future; in this journey, he had also planned to spread the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

With the Martial Temple at his disposal, Lin Yuan could avoid many detours. There was no need to start from scratch to build a force and then propagate the Martial Tao.

“I am willing,”

Lin Yuan nodded and said.

“Willing?”

The Great Supreme Elder and the other Supreme Elders exchanged glances, their hearts easing with immense relief.
